notes:
Account snapshot: BluePeak CodeWorks is a regulated fintech (embedded brokerage platform) evaluating an enterprise code assistant for distributed engineering org (US + UK). Primary ask: low-latency IDE copilot with strict security and residency.

Key business drivers:
- Speed up engineer onboarding and code reviews (internal productivity).
- Reduce time-to-fix for production incidents via low-latency completions in the IDE.
- Maintain auditable trails for regulatory compliance.

Technical requirements / POC acceptance criteria (explicit):
- Streaming token latency in IDE: target 95th <= 120ms for single-user warm sessions; interactive edits perceived as instant.
- Cold-start throughput: support 150 concurrent active developers during peak (spikes to 300).
- Model/version pinning per team + canary rollouts; must support rollback to quantized variant automatically on pod failures.
- Prefix/KV caching across sessions for shared repo context; cache eviction policies configurable.
- Fallback routing: region-aware fallback to nearest compatible model variant with <1s degrade.
- Audit logs and retention: immutable audit logging with export for 7 years; admin-level retention controls and queryable event store.
- Identity: SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning, optional MFA enforcement, per-role access controls.
- Key management: integrate with existing HSM/KMS (AWS KMS + on-prem HSM) for workspace keys.
- Data residency: customer data must remain in NA region for primary production; option to replicate to EU for dev/test.
